annotations.title: DOE / NNSA National Lab M&O Subcontract & DEAR (48 CFR Ch. 9) Compliance Auditor

description: Audit DOE/NNSA Management & Operating (M&O) National Laboratory solicitations (Sandia, LANL, ORNL, LLNL) for DEAR 48 CFR 952/970 clauses, Q-Clearance / L-Clearance requirements, Foreign National Unclassified Visits (DOE O 142.3B), and patent waivers. Returns a strictly validated `DoeDearSubcontractResponse` JSON object containing `doe_national_lab_subcontract_overview`, `dear_48_cfr_952_970_clause_audit_matrix`, `q_l_clearance_foci_and_doe_o_142_3b_controls`, and `patent_rights_and_crada_tech_transfer_strategy` grounded in 48 CFR Chapter 9 (DEAR Parts 952 & 970), 10 CFR Part 710 (Q/L Access Authorizations), DOE O 142.3B, & DOE O 470.4B. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive GovCon compliance and capture analysis call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key or X-SignalTender-Key; `doe_national_lab_rfp_and_dear_clauses_text` accepts 15 to 45,000 characters, while `target_national_lab_and_mando_prime` and `clearance_and_ip_posture` calibrate the regulatory regime and threshold assumptions). Use this tool when executing DOE / NNSA National Lab M&O Subcontract & DEAR (48 CFR Ch. 9) Compliance Auditor workflows; use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead for general FAR/DFARS clause flow-down audits, or `generate_compliance_matrix` for general Section L/M 'shall' requirement extraction.

clearance_and_ip_posture.default: DOE Q-Clearance / L-Clearance Cross-Over from DoD TS/Secret + Domestic Small Business Patent Retention (DEAR 952.227-11)
clearance_and_ip_posture.description: Operational context, threshold parameters, or compliance posture assumptions (defaults to 'DOE Q-Clearance / L-Clearance Cross-Over from DoD TS/Secret + Domestic Small Business Patent Retention (DEAR 952.227-11)').

doe_national_lab_rfp_and_dear_clauses_te.description: Primary solicitation text, clause excerpts, deliverable schedule, or technical/financial context for DOE / NNSA National Lab M&O Subcontract & DEAR (48 CFR Ch. 9) Compliance Auditor (15 to 45,000 characters).

target_national_lab_and_mando_prime.description: Target regulatory regime, statutory authority, or evaluation framework (defaults to 'Sandia_National_Laboratories_NTESS_And_Los_Alamos_National_Lab_Triad_NNSA').

name: generate_doe_national_lab_mando_subcontract

dear_48_cfr_952_970_clause_audit_matrix.description: Structured line-by-line regulatory audit, classification, or quantitative schedule rows.

doe_national_lab_subcontract_overview.description: Executive determination overview, regulatory citations, and readiness score.

patent_rights_and_crada_tech_transfer_st.description: Statutory governance protocol and actionable submission verification checklist.

q_l_clearance_foci_and_doe_o_142_3b_cont.description: Paste-ready compliance narratives, control specifications, or submission sections.
